action.counterAndCancelPolicy: Retain central final-moveset values unless that owner explicitly supersedes them; this resolution changes collision,production staging and close-selector only.

proximityPatch.distanceTest: absolute root-center separation <=9000 at request acceptance, existing enabled/stance/ground gates retained
proximityPatch.guaranteeScope: First-active positive-area overlap for stationary baseline standing/crouching targets at any legal ground push separation through90px, both facings by exact mirroring. Movement, jump,invulnerability and state changes during7f startup can still evade. Not a guaranteed hit or a claim that every later active key hits every crouch.

hitboxTimeline.sweptContactRule: First-active boxes represent the real fixed blade path from endf6 to endf7. Later boxes cover only current/previous active steel path, not a lingering full-height trail. Each rectangle remains one hit group; no repeat hit from crossing both boxes.
hitboxTimeline.laterLowProfileBehavior: Only first active tick includes the low part of the rising sweep. Later high blade positions may miss low crouching bodies; intentional and visually honest. On first-active contact every baseline crouching pose tested is hit or blocks normally.

hurtboxTimeline.basis: absolute actionframe, one record per tick; body boxes always on, extension covers previous-to-current anatomical arm sweep including glove, never weapon
hurtboxTimeline.resetOnFrame24: Return to current chosen locomotion/ready collision; do not retain this attack extension after move ends.
hurtboxTimeline.reasonForBodyRefit: Old generic narrow legs/behind-center head did not fit the selected wide Stalker stance or forward head; explicit production body envelopes now cover planted boots,passive arm,torso,head and attacking arm.

productionRig.units: all coordinates raw hundredths of world pixel, local to physical root, facingright; mirror whole rig for facingleft
productionRig.anatomicalHandOwnership: LEFT short blade; RIGHT long blade; screen side never reassigns knives.
productionRig.fixedGeometryPolicy: Blade templates/vectors never scale, morph,swaphands or flipgrip between keys. Integer rounding is less than0.01worldpixel in blade length and bone placement. Production art follows this rig rather than literal concept-image pixels.
productionRig.elbowSolve: Both arm segments2400. Given shoulderS,wristW,d=W-S,h=sqrt(2400^2-|d|^2/4), elbow=(S+W)/2 + (dy,-dx)/|d|*h; round each coordinate to nearest raw integer. This chooses same elbow-down branch.
productionRig.inbetween: Linear integer interpolation of wrist control keys per actor tick; solve elbow each tick; fixed heel/grip offsets; do not interpolate or stretch bone length.
productionRig.firstActivePath: From f6 heel(62,86),tip(70,65.51) to f7 heel(62,128),tip(70,107.51), in worldpx. This is one fast upward cut with point still down. Source concepts are pose-direction references; this registered extension supplies the selected72px effective reach.
productionRig.rootPolicy: All production localroot offsets[0,0]. Run entry uses65% inherited velocity and90 friction, not an additional drawing lunge. Foot support may follow underlying run entry; neutral entry uses declared planted feet.

castGeometryVerification.method: Read pinned manifest and fighter_collision; reproduce generator outward integer rounding. For each standing/idle and crouching pose, enumerate every legal integer root separation from both pushhalfwidths to9000. Opponent faces attacker; strictpositive overlap of rectangles required. Mirroring preserves these conditions.
castGeometryVerification.latestBranchAwareness: Root confirmed neutral anatomy is unchanged through cd8b0cedabfd508b0d82be2841d640e37928ef91. This calculation reads the exact source files/hashes listed; no claim of executing the latest native core.
castGeometryVerification.notGameplayValidation: This is exact static geometry validation. Does not execute core behavior,blockadvantage,inputrouting,rollback or production sprites.
